name: IFRS 9 & Expected Credit Loss Advisory
description: Engagements concerning IFRS 9 financial instruments standard implementation, gap analysis, and advisory. Covers expected credit loss (ECL) calculation model development, staging criteria, and credit risk impairment quantification. Also encompasses third-party validation of ECL models, impairment automation software procurement, and related stress testing advisory for financial institutions.

name: Audit & Assurance Services
description: Professional statutory external audit, interim reviews, and comprehensive financial statement examinations for banks, corporations, and development bodies. Covers internal audit out-sourcing, concurrent audits, branch inspection, forensic fraud investigation, and donor-funded project audits. Includes information systems (IS/IT) security audit and performance audits conducted under national and international auditing standards.

name: Risk Management & Internal Control Framework
description: Consultancy and diagnostic engagements focusing on Enterprise Risk Management (ERM), internal control over financial reporting (ICFR), and COSO framework implementation. Covers Asset Quality Review (AQR), banking diagnostic studies, Basel II/III capital adequacy advisory, and operational risk assessments. Involves evaluating regulatory compliance systems and institutional governance structures for financial sector entities.

name: Accounting & Financial Reporting Advisory
description: Advisory services for the adoption, conversion, and continuous compliance with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) and International Accounting Standards (IAS). Encompasses developing accounting manuals, chart of accounts restructuring, and financial reporting policy formulation. Includes review of financial statements and modernization of corporate finance departments.

name: Business Process Review & Advisory
description: Engagements dedicated to business process review, re-engineering (BPR), and operational workflow optimization. Covers drafting Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), As-Is and To-Be diagnostic assessments, and organizational restructuring. Involves advisory on ERP implementation controls, change management, and general management consultancy.

name: Taxation & VAT Advisory
description: Professional direct and indirect tax consultancy services under Bangladesh Income Tax and VAT legislation. Encompasses corporate tax compliance, tax planning, withholding tax audit, transfer pricing documentation, and dispute resolution representation. Covers VAT accounting system design and compliance health checks for corporate clients.

name: Financial Advisory & Corporate Finance
description: Transaction advisory services encompassing buy-side and sell-side financial due diligence, business enterprise valuation, and financial feasibility studies. Includes financial modelling, capital restructuring, mergers and acquisitions advisory, and project appraisal. Focuses on independent economic analysis and investment evaluation for sponsors and lenders.

name: Professional Training & Capacity Building
description: Institutional executive education and capacity-building workshops delivered to finance, risk, and audit professionals. Covers practical training on IFRS standards, internal audit methodologies, AML/CFT compliance, and risk management frameworks. Customized for banking institutions, public sector corporations, and regulatory agencies.

name: Other Professional Advisory Services
description: Miscellaneous professional consultancy and advisory engagements that an established chartered accountancy and management consulting firm realistically delivers. Involves specialized institutional research, policy development, governance review, or socio-economic impact studies.
